meta.name: add-codex
meta.description: Use Codex (OpenAI's codex app-server) as a full agent provider — planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history, session resume — alongside or instead of Claude. ChatGPT subscription or OpenAI API key, vault-only via the selected gateway. Per-group via `ncl groups config update --provider codex`. Distinct from using OpenAI as an MCP tool (where Claude remains the planner).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 Codex 接入为编码代理,可与 Claude 并存或互相替换
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让 Codex 和 Claude 同时当编码代理,并能按分组自由切换。
copy.tagline_en: Plug Codex in as a coding agent you can run beside or instead of Claude
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want Codex and Claude as interchangeable coding agents per group.

howto.what: 装上后,可把某个组的 Agent 后端从 Claude 换成 Codex(OpenAI 的 codex app-server):由 Codex 规划、编排工具,会话历史存服务端并可恢复。凭据只存 OneCLI 保险库,容器里读不到明文密钥。
howto.when: 当你要求把某个 NanoClaw 组的 Agent 后端切换到 Codex(用 ncl groups config update),或需要安装、认证 Codex provider 时触发。新组默认仍是 claude,要手动切换。

say.text: 把 Codex 装成 agent provider
say.note: 执行安装步骤,并在 OneCLI 保险库完成认证

say.text: 把 <group-id> 这个组的 provider 换成 codex 并重启
say.note: 该组之后由 Codex 作为后端运行

say.text: 把新组的默认 provider 设成 codex
say.note: 只影响之后新建的组,已有组不变

howto.what_en: Installs Codex (OpenAI's codex app-server) as an agent provider, so a group's backend can be Codex instead of Claude. It plans, orchestrates tools, keeps server-side history and resumes sessions. Credentials live only in the OneCLI vault.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want a NanoClaw group's agent backend switched to Codex (per group via ncl groups config update), or when installing the Codex provider. New groups default to Claude until set.

say_en.text: Install Codex as an agent provider
say_en.note: Runs the install steps and vault auth

say_en.text: Switch group <group-id> to the codex provider and restart it
say_en.note: That group then runs on Codex

say_en.text: Set codex as the default provider for new groups
say_en.note: Only groups created later use Codex
